qualification.details: Para Pump Operator: Matriculation (10th) with ITI certificate in Electrician / Wireman / diesel mechanic / Pump Mechanic / Motor Mechanic / Pump Operator cum Mechanic / Mechanic (Motor Vehicle) / Pump Mechanic from a recognized ITI or Matriculation (10th) with Certificate under skill Development Scheme of the Government. Para Fitter: Matriculation (10th) with ITI certificate in Fitter / Plumber from recognized ITI or Matriculation (10th) with certificate under skill Development Scheme of the Government. Multipurpose Worker: Middle pass (8th) or its equivalent from school duly recognized by the State Government.

content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://www.jsv.hp.gov.in. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Himachal Pradesh Jal Shakti Vibhag recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Himachal Pradesh Jal Shakti Vibhag recruitment is 22nd September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the different posts available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The Himachal Pradesh Jal Shakti Vibhag is recruiting for three posts: Para Pump Operator, Para Fitter, and Multipurpose Worker.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies released?
faq.answer: A total of 10 vacancies have been released by the Himachal Pradesh Jal Shakti Vibhag for these posts.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit for applicants is 18 years, and the maximum age limit is 45 years. Age relaxation may be applicable as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for the Multipurpose Worker post?
faq.answer: For the Multipurpose Worker post, candidates must have passed Middle School (8th standard) or an equivalent examination from a school recognized by the State Government.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Para Pump Operator and Para Fitter posts?
faq.answer: Both Para Pump Operator and Para Fitter posts offer a monthly salary of Rs. 7100/-.

faq.question: Q8. How will the candidates be selected for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts will involve Document Evaluation and a Skill/Physical Test.

faq.question: Q9. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their application forms to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Himachal Pradesh Jal Shakti Vibhag, which is https://www.jsv.hp.gov.in.
